fields.af_uses: How many Ace Frontier text entries (EBOOT, mission scripts, unit lists) contain the Japanese name or one of its ja_aliases. 0 = not in the dumped text; the name can still be heard in voice clips
fields.songs: Song and BGM titles (EBOOT BGM list and sound test). en = MUF's translation when MUF had the song, else the Macross Wiki article title, else the title as written when it is already English
fields.skills: Pilot skill names (EBOOT 0x26C664-). en = MUF's translation; 'open' = not translated yet
fields.ranks: Military ranks and titles shown in profiles. en = MUF's translation (abbreviated for the profile box)
fields.missions: Mission titles. status 'term': a glossary term or series title. 'episode': the title is an anime episode or film title, use the official English title (MUF wording where MUF already chose one). 'muf': MUF translated the same title. 'open': game original, translate freely
fields.status: verified / decided / muf (taken from the MUF translation) / wiki / episode / as_written / provisional / needs_research / open
fields.tf_uses: How many Triangle Frontier text entries outside the campus mode (EBOOT, menu CSVs, mission scripts, unit lists) contain the Japanese name or a ja_aliases form. 0 = not in the dumped text; it can still be heard in voice clips
fields.tf_campus_uses: How many campus event script lines contain the name
fields.muf_role: Role in Macross Ultimate Frontier, kept from the MUF glossary
